from pathlib import Path
# 32-bit Mach-O header + one LC_SEGMENT command with cmdsize 56 and no sections.

import struct
magic=0xfeedface
cputype=7
cpusubtype=3
filetype=2
ncmds=1
sizeofcmds=56
flags=0
hdr=struct.pack('<7I', magic,cputype,cpusubtype,filetype,ncmds,sizeofcmds,flags)
cmd=1
cmdsize=56
segname=b'__TEXT'+b'\x00'*10
vmaddr=0x1000
vmsize=0x1000
fileoff=0x1000
filesize=0x1000
maxprot=7
initprot=5
nsects=0
segflags=0
seg=struct.pack('<II16sIIIIIIII', cmd,cmdsize,segname,vmaddr,vmsize,fileoff,filesize,maxprot,initprot,nsects,segflags)
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(hdr+seg)
print(len(hdr+seg))
